notes: Added required stories for EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN feature.

change_log.note: Phase 2 requirement: define travel burden schema
Phase 2 requirement: expose via Evaluate Care

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S1.title: Define Travel Burden Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S1.description: Define structured schema for travel distance, duration, and metadata (origin, destination, mode, units) returned from travel computation.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S2.title: Implement Travel Distance and Time Computation Logic
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S2.description: Implement core logic to call Google Routes API and compute travel distance and duration between user location and trial sites, including error handling and fallback behavior.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S3.title: Integrate Travel Burden into Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S3.description: Expose computed travel distance and duration as part of clinical trial results returned by evaluate_care_facade, ensuring consistent formatting with other trial attributes.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden Computation
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S4.description: Create unit tests for travel calculation logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from trial search to travel burden output, including API failure scenarios.
